BiblicalUsage: The LORD warns that He will root Israel up out of the good land if they turn to other gods, and He warns again that He will pluck them up by the roots out of the land He gave them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that being rooted in God's land is a gift, not a right: the same hand that planted Israel can pull it up, and the warning is given so that I will stay planted by obedience.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
